post.description:
Run one framework directly as a one-stage ``adhoc`` cycle.

Same engine, persistence and event stream as a named cycle: progress and
status live under ``/cycle-executions/{execution_id}``.

get.description:
Per-test added/removed/regression/fix breakdown -- UI parity with ``qasight diff``.

Computed on-demand from each run's own artifact snapshot every request (no
caching): extracts both snapshots into a temp dir and matches cases by
historyId/fullName/uuid, same as the CLI's full (non ``--metrics-only``) diff.

Flaky tests in a cycle's last runs (retries, same-commit results, flips per branch).

Tests that failed every one of their last runs come back as ``broken`` instead.

UI parity with ``qasight flaky --cycle``; see ``qasight/services/flaky_service.py``.

The issues a cycle's tests point at (issue links and ``issue`` labels), red ones first.

An issue is failing when one of its tests failed in its latest run. Read-only: the
issue tracker is never called. See ``qasight/services/test_issues.py``.

A cycle's tests counted by label (feature, story, severity, owner, tag...).

Each label's tests, how many failed in their latest run and how many are flaky,
features first. See ``qasight/services/test_labels.py``.
One test in each of a cycle's last runs, newest first, with its last failure.
Every test in a cycle's last runs: outcomes, flaky or not, durations and slowdowns.

get.description: The latest run of ``cycle`` (any cycle when omitted) as an SVG badge.

post.description:
Stop a run: a queued one never starts; a running one's stages get SIGTERM.

Send it again to kill stages that ignore SIGTERM. The run is still recorded, as
failed with ``interrupted_by`` set; its status here becomes ``cancelled``.

get.description: Every cycle in the config (as ``qasight cycles list``), then cycles that only have recorded runs.
Resolved view of one cycle (as ``qasight cycles show <name>``), or a recorded-only cycle.

post.description: Start a run of ``cycle``; with ``tests`` or ``rerun_failed``, only those tests.

get.description: Red cycles (most new failures first), newly flaky tests and tests that got slower.
Time to fix, open failures by age, CI time and default-branch red time over the last ``days``.

post.description:
Record JUnit XML files as one run of *cycle*. Nothing in the upload is executed.

``exit_code`` follows ``qasight run``: 0 when every test passed or was skipped,
1 when one failed. Needs ``Authorization: Bearer <TESTO_API_TOKEN>`` when the
server has a token set, like every other write.

get.description: The project under test's test health score: every cycle, or ``cycle`` alone.
The last AI review of the scope, if any; ``stale`` when newer runs came in.

post.description: Ask the configured AI provider to review the project with the chosen skills.

get.description: The review skills the AI review can use, each with what it checks and reads.

delete.description: Release a test: its failures fail runs again.

get.description:
Every quarantined test kept on the server, newest first, optionally one cycle's.

``qasight.yaml`` rules aren't listed here; runs apply both.

put.description: Quarantine a test (exact name or glob) in a cycle; replaces an earlier entry for it.

get.description: Every release a run recorded (``qasight run --release``), newest first.

One release: each cycle's latest run in it, its failing and flaky tests, and what
changed from the release before (new failures, fixed tests).
How testing went over the last ``period``, against the period before, for every cycle or ``cycle``.

get.description:
The report as a file: the same as ``qasight export FORMAT`` on this server's history.

PDF and PNG need the ``export`` extra and Chromium on the server; PowerPoint and
Excel need the ``export`` extra; HTML needs the built UI (bundled in released wheels).

200.description: The report file, as an attachment.

501.description: This server can't make that format (the message says what to install).

get.description: Every pool the server knows, with each key's holder and how many requests wait.
Provider commands people ran (``qasight pool add/remove/sweep --apply``), newest first.

post.description: Log a provider command a client ran. The server never runs one itself.
Take a broken key out of its pool; nobody gets it until it is enabled again.
Put a key back in its pool.
Take a key back from whoever holds it (admin). Their next heartbeat finds it gone.
Take a free key, or say how many requests are ahead. Ask again (same ``waiter_id``) to wait.

delete.description: Give a key back. ``clean=true``: the holder reset it, so the next taker may skip a reset.

post.description: Keep a lease. 404 means it is gone: it expired, or an admin took the key back.

get.description:
How long runs are kept (``history.retention``) and the default stage time limit.

Read from ``qasight.yaml``, with ``TESTO_RETENTION_DAYS`` /
``TESTO_RETENTION_RUNS_PER_CYCLE`` on top (they also work without a file). The
server reads retention when it starts, so restart it after an edit.
Recent runs, newest first; ``cycle`` keeps only that cycle's.
The run's failing tests: message, stage, how long each has been failing, flaky or not.

The run as Markdown (headline, stages, failing tests, changes since its baseline).

The same text as ``qasight report markdown --run-id``, so the UI's "Copy summary"
pastes into a pull request, Confluence, Notion or Jira the way the CLI's does.
Unit/integration/e2e tier composition for a run (UI/API parity with ``qasight report pyramid``).

post.description:
Delete the chosen runs: rows, per-test rows and report copies. Can't be undone.

A run still running is skipped. In accounts mode this needs the admin role.

Every scored project, the latest first, with its versions and their scores.
